events.title: Birds of Play - it's time!
events.summary: Have you seen the news?! Today kicks off the weeklong even BIRDS OF PLAY right here on Steam, showcasing 140 participating bird games dedicated to our feathered friends!Check it out right here!Whether you're looking to solve mysteries, simulate flight, or just spot rare species, the event features curated categories around platforms and genres, and we’ve also got some special twists, including:Be a Bird: Immersive bird simulators and flight-focused titles.Birds on the Case: Detective and mystery

events.title: Birds of Play Launch
events.summary: We're proud to host the opening stream of Birds of Play, a Steam event that is all about games with birds.Here we present to you a glorious selection of bird games. We've got something for everyone - whether you want to experience being a bird, want to feel the thrill of birdwatching, or just love some quirky bird characters. We've got exclusive demos, new releases, and plenty of discounts. In Birds of Play, enjoy over 130 bird games sorted into categories just for you!

events.title: Launch date announcement: November 16th 2026
events.summary: Sparrow Warfare is a one-of-a-kind deckbuilder x boss rush game. How do you play? By combining three mahjong-like tiles to create the wildest synergies. No mahjong knowledge necessary.In Sparrow Warfare you are the last free bird. The evil storyteller has enthralled all your feathered friends, trapping them in mahjong tiles and sending them out against you. events.title: Development Roadmap Part II
events.summary: We will finish this game by Q4 2026 and until then there's a lot to do. It's interesting to make a full game as a team of two because you can experience how your focus shifts between the areas that require the most attention over the duration of the project. It all starts out with design, finding the backstory, making a technical framework and deciding on a visual language. events.title: Patch Notes, v0.4.37
events.summary: This is easily the biggest update to the demo since we launched. It adds a whole new subsystem for building your little tile-powered engine: discarding for profit. We were looking for ways to encourage discarding tiles for a while and now we've finally found a good one: adding status tiles that sit in your hand until you find a way to remove them. events.title: Patch notes, demo-0.4.29

Gameplay changes:Add Misery modifier proposed (discard a random tile when you discard a tile)The “fully heal” tile now also removes burningBugfixes:Cleaned up the start menu a bit and new players get a Tutorial buttonMade the help overlay more conciseFix bug where playing X-2-4 doesn’t sort the wildtile in correctlyBetter hint
